name: heading
label: Heading
default: How every order moves through HotWax

name: intro
label: Intro
help_text: One or two sentences under the heading. Leave empty to hide it.
default: Your sales channels, warehouses, stores, and ERP, connected in one OMS, HotWax Commerce. Every order sells from real stock, routes to the right location, and stays tracked until it’s delivered, picked up, or returned.

name: steps
label: Steps
help_text: Each step gets a numbered hex on the line, in this order. Keep titles short (about 20 characters) so they fit one or two lines.

default.title: Sellable
default.text: One live count of stock across every location, minus what’s promised or held back.

default.title: Routed
default.text: Your rules route each order to the location best placed to fill it.

default.title: Picked and packed
default.text: The team at that location scans each item, then picks and packs the order.

default.title: Shipped or picked up
default.text: Shipped with a label and tracking, or handed over at pickup.

default.title: Back on sale
default.text: Returns and exchanges go back into sellable stock as soon as they’re received.
